name: reh11_tract_list
description: REH test 3: GetTractsInRadius over 8 x 8 tracts of 64 m, centre (32, 32) m. Radius 60: bounds 0..1; (0, 1) has d^2 = 4096 > 3600 and (1, 1) 8192, so only (0, 0). Radius 100: bounds 0..2; (0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1) in x-major order ((0, 2) has 16384 > 10000). Centre (-10, 32), radius 100: x0 = trunc(-1.71875) = -1, clamped to 0. The upper bounds compare unsigned: a negative upper bound becomes count - 1 (centre (-200, 32), radius 10: x0 = 0, x1 = 7, and no tract is in range).
